long_biography.plain_text:
American industrialist David McDonald made reliable delivery a central promise at Pelco. Factory schedules could change to fulfil a customer's order that day, while employees answered calls personally and took responsibility for resolving problems. He also gave staff the authority to satisfy customers without seeking permission at every step.

His affection for animals found a lasting expression in the Miss Winkles Pet Adoption Center, which he helped fund in Clovis. It was named after his West Highland terrier. He also chaired the original campaign to support Fresno Chaffee Zoo through a sales tax. Years later, noticing visitors struggling with its unpaved paths, he paid for improvements.

Forbes, LinkedIn, Instagram and personal websites were checked, followed by Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok and Wikipedia. Results were unrelated namesakes or third-party memorial coverage; no verified personal account was found. No former employer or successor's website is substituted for a personal profile. Ancillary Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor and Zillow searches also yielded no attributable account; the VFX artist and Florida real-estate agent are namesakes.

Only active Aviation is assigned. Industrial surveillance cameras do not satisfy Consumer electronics or Cybersecurity. Apparel was an early venture without proved defining materiality; charitable work does not automatically satisfy Humanitarian aid or Environmental conservation. No taxonomy candidate is created.

The family text was read directly at GV Wire rather than relying on the blocked Legacy mirror.
